_why: Phase 3 (health ledger that cannot lie) was built in a worktree while other agents edited config/data_source_authority.json and scripts/run_cio_hardening_ci.py. Nothing below was applied; the coordinator registers it. Each entry says which file and what to add.

fred._why: report_source('fred') now called from external_market_data_ingest.ingest_fred (cron 15 6 * * * via fred_data_ingest.py --ingest), fred_data_ingest.ingest_history (--history, operator), and lib/financial_senses/macro_provider.FredClient._get (live fetches only).

alpha_vantage._why: report_source('alpha_vantage') now called from external_market_data_ingest.ingest_alpha_vantage (cron 0 8 * * 1 --fundamentals), ingest_av_news_sentiment (--news-sentiment/--all, unscheduled) and catalyst_enrichment._fetch_alpha_vantage (flag-gated ENABLE_ALPHA_VANTAGE_CATALYST, on demand).

domains_to_add._why: Without a domain whose primary_provider is fred, lib/data_source_health_view gives the fred row the 24h default window. The lane runs daily at 06:15; 48h tolerates one missed run before decaying to unknown.
domains_to_add._writer_note: fred_data_ingest.py imports ingest_fred from external_market_data_ingest.py; both write fred_economic_series. Writer-count baseline for this store is 2 today.

domains_to_add._why: The lane is WEEKLY. With the 24h default window alpha_vantage decays to unknown six days out of seven and the hourly audit would alert every Monday and Tuesday. 192h = 8 days: one missed Monday decays it.

domain_field_updates._why: brave_search is on-demand (aegis_transcript_discovery 09:00 Mon-Fri, aegis_social_sentiment 11:00/15:00 Mon-Fri call brave_router). null falls through to the 24h default and decays every weekend. 72h covers Friday 15:00 to Monday 09:00. OPTIONAL: leave null if weekend decay is wanted.
